<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex10032023-07-2412-45-04" status="reviewed">
         <lg><l>thugs sbyangs stobs kyis smra ba'i seng ger grags ||</l>
         <l>nyi zla bzhin du ma rig nyon mongs sel ||</l>
         <l>bsdu' bzhis bdag sogs 'gon med smin grol mdzad ||</l>
         <l>zung 'jug mtshan don ldan pa khyed la 'dud ||</l></lg>
         
        <lg> <l>chos kyis 'phongs pa'i <expan>sems can</expan> la ||</l>
         <l>rgyas 'bring rtogs pas tshim mdzad pa ||</l>
         <l><lb n="108a5"/> de bzhin bdag gis <expan>sems can</expan> rnams ||</l>
         <l>'phrin las rnaMs kyis tshim byed shog ||</l></lg>
         
         <lg><l>bla ma bde' bar gshegs pa'i gsung zab cing rgya che ba thugs<anchor xml:id="a1"/> su chud nas gzhan la ston pas 'khor ba'i mun nag du 'khyaMs pa'i long khrid pa ||<note type="translation">Having impressed on one's mind the profound and extensive teaching of the bla ma, the Sugata, by teaching it to others, (you|one) lead the blinds who are roving in the darkness of cyclic existence.</note></l>
         <l>dbu' ma chen pos gdul bya mngon mtho' nges legs la 'god pas thar pa dang <expan>thams cad</expan> mkhyen pa'i skyed byed ||<note type="translation">The Great Madhyamaka generates liberation and omniscience by establishing the disciples in higher states of rebirth and ultimate bliss.</note></l></lg></seg></TEI>
